items.title: Visa Report: AI-Enabled Fraud and Third-Party Attacks Are Scaling Worldwide
items.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 17, 2026--Fraud is becoming more automated, targeted and global as criminals use AI to exploit weak points across the payments ecosystem and target third-party providers that can provide access to multiple downstream payment organizations, according to the Visa (NYSE: V) Fall 2026 Biannual Threats Report released today during International Fraud Awareness Week.
